info.title: Waaru Developer API
info.description: Source contract for this release; deployment requires release verification. Keys remain number-bound. Explicit workspace:* scopes cover shared workspace contacts/static segments. Scoped reads work alongside Logic Flow and for retained disconnected-number data, subject to lifecycle fences. Autonomous sends and workspace writes still require connected EXTERNAL_API handling. Callback management requires a connected number but grants no reply ownership. Every scope is explicit; existing keys gain none. Unknown input fields are rejected. Consent, sender identity, service windows, template freshness/quality, rate/backlog and human-priority rules remain authoritative.

get.description: Requires messages:read. Bootstrap without after and save resumeCursor before retained history reconciliation. Then follow nextCursor, including empty pages, and persist resumeCursor for the next polling cycle. Ordered by immutable workspace revision with a fixed cycle watermark; delivery status comes from that observation, not current message state. Outbound creation status is null. Cursor lease is seven days (410 cursor_expired); invalid or wrong-number cursor is 400 invalid_cursor. history=retained_only: deletions have no tombstones and the lease is not a history-retention promise. No send or reply authority.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist one unique value per logical send. Same normalized recipient and content repeats acceptance; changed request returns409. Scope is workspace and number, including after key rotation.

parameters.name: X-Waaru-Require-Authentication
parameters.description: Set to true to require an AUTHENTICATION template before persistence. This stricter mode is part of idempotency identity; use the same header when replaying a request.

patch.description: Requires workspace:contacts:write. Update profile fields or explicitly restoreArchived:true with expectedRevision from an exact archived read. Omitted/false never restores; stale archived revision returns 409 contact_archive_changed. Restore and profile changes commit together without changing opt-outs, restrictions or history, or recreating removed segment memberships. Active restoration is a no-op before revision comparison; ordinary profile concurrency is unchanged.

name.description: After NFKC normalization, trimming and whitespace collapsing, the name must contain 1 to 48 characters. The 48-character maximum does not apply to the raw input. The request body limit is 4096 bytes.

callbackUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL, port 443, no credentials/query/fragment. Required for creation. DNS validation is enforced.

observeAllOrigins.description: Explicitly observe supported native/API message origins without reply authority. Send true on every replacement PUT to retain all-origin observation; omission restores legacy API-handler events. No historical replay.
